findings.title: Subdivision limit adds an unsupported configuration constraint
findings.description: The design hard-rejects subdivision factors above 8 based on a speculative auxiliary-memory risk. The parent architecture says memory is not a roadmap constraint, and the slice plan calls for configurable subdivision with S=1 by default and S=3 for bench runs, but sets no maximum. Defer this arbitrary cap unless measurements show it is necessary; otherwise it adds policy and validation beyond the slice’s stated need.
